book.name: KOLOSI
book.title: KOLOSI Kolosi mbal tuku waŋe Paulusŋge kuyarna

content: Piro kulat mbal tuku pasa
Piro taŋgo tuku gabat mbal, tane maŋau tiŋreknumbi taŋgine piro mbal kulatkap. Tane mata taŋgine Suŋgo samba mbolŋge minit ta gilai ndaŋgap.
Wam pagu pasa yeki yeki
Tane kanyum ndamba wamdus suŋgo ŋak yabaŋmba minmba Kuate gare pasa tape.

Tane sine tuku mata Kuate yabaŋap le nu sine pasa mayenu kukliwam tuku ndin tumsiŋguwa le sine Kristus tuku wam te-mayokbe. Wam ta buk kuirok minna ta kile kilimok minit. Ye wam ta kukliwen tukunu kile ye muli wandek sinamŋge minet.
Tane Kuate yabaŋap le ye kumumbi pasa ta te-mayoki le nane ismba katesewaig.
Tane Kuate dubi ndade mbal tugumŋge minig ta wamdus kuyar mayenu ŋak mbal taŋaŋ minap. Ait afu wam magenu ke likam tuku prode ta ake kusre ndakap.
Tane nyamagaŋ sol ŋak taŋaŋ pasa kikoŋnu ndo saka minap. Taŋamba tane nane afu tuku pasa kumumbi lafuwamŋgaig.
Siŋgine gulab Tikikus nu sine turka sine ndoŋ Suŋgo tuku piroka ye tuku piro tuma minit. Nu tane tugum prowa sulumba ye tuku wam ŋakmba kubewamŋgat.
Sine mineg maŋau te nuŋge tane kila satiŋmba tane tuku ŋgamuŋgal wamdus bul sertiŋguwa ŋga ye nu kukulet.
Tane tuku taŋgo Onesimus nu mata Tikikus ndoŋ tane tugum kuwaik ŋga sawet. Nu siŋgine gulab nu Kristus dubi mayete. Nale ar taŋge wam ŋakmba teŋge mayok ke likade ta kubeu tiŋgamŋgaik.

Aristarkus nu ye ndoŋ muli wandek sinam teŋge minek nu tane gare pasa tiŋgit. Barnabas ndaret nuŋe Markus nu mata tane gare pasa tiŋgit. Ye o buk tane satiŋgen taŋamba kile maŋ satiŋget. Nu tane tugum prowa kande nu tap.

Taŋgo ande Yesus mape nyu Yustus nu mata tane gare pasa tiŋgit. Yiŋe piro mbal ŋgamukŋge nane keŋ ta ndo Zu taŋgo minmba Kuate tuku gageu afu kilam tuku pirokade. Nane mbolŋge ye ŋgamuŋgal wamdus bulkate.

Tane tuku taŋgo Epafras Yesus Kristus tuku piro taŋgo nu mata tane gare pasa tiŋgit. Tane saŋgri tiŋga sugoka Kuate tuku nzali ŋakmba kila palpe ŋga nu wamdus saŋgrinu pilmba mara mara tane tuku ŋga Kuate yabaŋte.
Nu tane tuku Laodisea mbal tuku Hirapolis mbal tuku piro saŋgrite le kaŋgeret.
Siŋgine gulab dokta Lukas nale Demas ndoŋ tane gare pasa tiŋgik.
Siŋgine tira kame Laodiseaŋge minig ta sine tuku gare pasa te saniŋgap. Nimfa ŋgade pino ta Kuate tuku kuasmbi nu tuku wandekŋge maŋgurkade ndoŋ siŋgine gare pasa nane mata saniŋgap.
Tane waŋe te bur suluwap sulumba Laodisea mbal burkam tuku niŋgap. Ye Laodisea mbal tuku waŋe ande kuyarmba pilen ta tane mata waŋe ta tumba burkap.
Tane Arkipus sawap le nu wamdus ndindo ndo tumba Kuate tuku piro tina ta suluwa.
Ye Paulus kile yiŋe waimbi kaiye pasa te kuyaramŋgit. Tane ŋakmba kaiye. Ye muli wandek sinamŋge minet te tane ye gilai ndaŋgap. Kuate nu tane ake sinaŋ make patikuwa. Son.
